entities.summary: Felix Mallard is an Australian actor and musician. He began his career playing Ben Kirk in the soap opera Neighbours (2014–2019). He has since starred in the CBS comedy Happy Together (2018–2019) and in the Netflix series Ginny & Georgia (2021–present). He also had recurring roles in Locke & Key (2020–2021), also on Netflix, and in the second season of Zoey's Extraordinary Playlist (2021) on NBC.
